content: Papa Parse 5.x (papaparse) API: Papa.parse(file, config) where config.header=true makes data rows into objects keyed by header names. Result: {data: Record<string,string>[], errors: ParseError[], meta: {fields: string[], delimiter, linebreak}}. Key options: skipEmptyLines (true or 'greedy'), dynamicTyping (converts nums/bools), complete(results, file) callback, error(err, file) callback. Types available via @types/papaparse. npm view shows version 5.5.4, @types/papaparse 5.5.2.
